notes.text:
M aged 64 yrs adm c arteriosclerotic CVA. He transferred torehabilitation two mths 
later where he developed hypostaticpneumonia, In ICU sputum 
cultured Klebsiella pneumoniae & pf died 2 days after admission 
to ICU. He also addicted to alcohol for past 20 yrs & on reguIar 
medication for IHD for last 10 yrs.
